 Alcorn State Set to Host Jackson State in Annual Soul Bowl
 11/20/2026 2:00:00 PM
 Story Links
 LORMAN, Miss. –LORMAN, Miss. – Alcorn State University football returns to Jack Spinks–Marino Casem Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 21, to close out the 2026 regular season against longtime rival Jackson State in the annual Soul Bowl. Kickoff is scheduled for 2:02 p.m. CST, with the game airing live on ESPN+ and WPRL 91.7 FM. 
 The Braves (6-5, 4-3 SWAC) enter the rivalry matchup looking to finish the season on a high note and secure their seventh victory of the year. Alcorn has been one of the conference's most explosive offensive teams, averaging 41.2 points and 479.0 yards per game behind senior quarterback and 2026 C Spire Conerly Trophy nominee Jaylon Tolbert . 
 Jackson State (7-5, 4-3 SWAC) travels to Lorman for the highly anticipated showdown as both programs look to close out conference play with a victory. The Braves will also celebrate Senior Day, recognizing their graduating student-athletes before kickoff. 
 Alcorn vs JSU 
 Nov.21, 2026 | 2:02 p.m. (CST) 
 Jack Spinks – Marino Casem Stadium  |  Lorman, MS 
 WPRL 91.7 FM (Radio) | ESPN+ (TV)

 Roster  |  Coaches  |  Schedule & Results  |  Stats 
 Jackson State 7-5 (4-3 SWAC) 
 Roster   |  Coaches  |  Schedule & Results  |  Stats 
 High-Powered Offense: Alcorn State enters Saturday averaging 41.2 points and 479.0 yards per game. The Braves have totaled 5,269 yards of offense and scored 62 touchdowns through 11 games. 
 Tolbert Named 2026 C Spire Conerly Trophy Nominee: Alcorn State senior quarterback Jaylon Tolbert has been named the Braves' nominee for the 2026 C Spire Conerly Trophy, which recognizes Mississippi's top college football player. Tolbert has put together an impressive senior campaign, throwing for 3,232 yards and 34 touchdowns while adding 365 rushing yards and three scores. He has accounted for 37 total touchdowns and 3,597 yards of total offense through 11 games. 
 Robertson's Offensive Impact: Fredrick Robertson leads the Braves with 777 rushing yards and 11 rushing touchdowns. He has added 397 receiving yards and five receiving touchdowns, totaling 1,174 all-purpose yards and 15 touchdowns. 
 Defensive Leaders: Timothy Jasper leads Alcorn with 75 tackles, followed by Mahamadou Diarra with 68 and Dillon Crowell with 65.  Jakel Houston-Irving leads the Braves with five sacks, while Elijah Ruffin has recorded a team-high three interceptions. 
 Home Finale and SWAC Standings: Alcorn State enters its regular-season finale with a 6-5 overall record and a 4-3 mark in SWAC play. The Braves are 3-1 at home this season and will look to close their campaign with a rivalry victory over Jackson State. 
 Last Time Out - 
 JACKSON, Miss. – Alcorn State closed out the 2025 football season with a hard-fought 27-21 loss to Jackson State on Saturday afternoon at Veterans Memorial Stadium. Despite falling behind 17-0 early, the Braves battled back with three touchdowns and a late comeback attempt. 
 Jaylon Tolbert  threw for 234 yards and two touchdowns, both to  Tyran Warren , who finished with seven receptions for 111 yards.  Reggie Davis  added 120 rushing yards and a 44-yard touchdown run. 
 Defensively,  Stemarion Edwards  led Alcorn with 12 tackles, while  Cedric Roberts  added 10. The Braves finished with 390 yards of total offense and closed the season at 5-7 overall and 4-4 in SWAC play. 
 The Broadcasts – 
 The game will be carried live on the Braves Radio Network in the form of WPRL 91.7 FM with Charles Edmond (play-by-play) operating alongside Cedric Tillman (sidelines). The game will also be streamed live on ESPN+. 
 The Coach – 
 Head Coach  Cedric Thomas  is now in his third year at the helm of the Alcorn Football program. The Arkansas-Pine Bluff graduate of 2001 holds a record of 17-18 overall with the Purple and Gold. He has never faced the Bears as a head coach in his career at either UAPB or Alcorn, respectively. 
 The Weather – 
 Sunny skies with temperatures around 74°F and a slight chance of rain.
